_comment: Fourth Floor fork: dependency versions raised above the upstream 2.x release to clear Dependabot alerts. Mirrors upstream master where it has moved; applied by extra/apply-deps.js after every upstream rebase.
_overrides_comment: Transitive packages whose parents pin a vulnerable range, so `npm audit fix` cannot raise them. Merged into package.json "overrides" by extra/apply-deps.js. tar/node-gyp chain: install-time helpers of @louislam/sqlite3. minimatch@>=7 and glob@>=9: the old glob 7 / minimatch 3 and 5 lines are not affected and are left alone. fast-xml-parser: gamedig pins an exact vulnerable version.
